profile.headline: Embedded Software Lead | SHPE Region 3 Vice President
profile.summary:
With nearly 10 years of experience in the aerospace industry, I have gained strong competencies in developing embedded software for real-time systems.

I am passionate about space craft development, space exploration and earth science applications, and I am always eager to learn new technologies and skills. My goal is to contribute the development and delivery of innovative space solutions that make a difference in the world.

positions.title: Flight Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Flight Software Engineer, I support the development of software for U.S government spacecraft applications. I work with a distributed team to design and develop device drivers for RTOS applications and perform hardware/software integration testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS) · Kernel Development · Git · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · C (Programming Language) · Device Drivers · Gitlab · Software Requirements · Python (Programming Language) · Debuggers · BSP · Debugging · Jira · C++

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description: In this role I collaborated with multi-disciplinary teams to generated Guidance, Navigation and Control software using MATLAB + Simulink. I also developed C source code for peripheral devices using an Eclipse-based IDE and operated Hardware-In-the-Loop test stands.
positions.insights: Skills: Simulink · Guidance Navigation & Control · Microcontrollers · Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART) · Flight Test · C (Programming Language) · MATLAB · Software Requirements · Tortoise SVN · Debuggers · Code Generation · Debugging

projects.title: Cryptocurrency Exchange Simulator
projects.description: Developed a command-line application in C++ to simulate a cryptocurrency trading exchange. Unit tests developed in GTest and documentation in Doxygen. Application parses CSV data for initial conditions and allows user to timestep through the simulation while performing various currency transactions.
